text.en: Welcome to English for Furniture Designers. This is Unit 1, Introduction to Furniture and Design.
text.ar: أهلاً بكم في الإنجليزية لمصمّمي الأثاث. هذه الوحدة الأولى، مقدّمة في الأثاث والتصميم.

text.en: This is Part 2, Grammar Practice. You will build four forms, then CHOOSE four.
text.ar: هذا الجزء الثاني، تدريب القواعد. ستبني أربع صيغ، ثمّ تختار أربعاً.

text.en: Eight sentences. The time phrase chooses the tense every time.
text.ar: ثماني جمل. عبارة الزمن هي التي تختار الزمن في كلّ مرّة.

text.en: The book does the first. Sami usually works in the morning.
text.ar: الكتاب يحلّ الأولى. Sami usually works in the morning.

text.en: Why the plain verb there? Because usually means every day, not now.
text.ar: لماذا الفعل المجرّد هناك؟ لأنّ usually تعني كلّ يوم، لا الآن.

text.en: Layla blank new sofas and chairs. The verb is design.
text.ar: Layla فراغ new sofas and chairs. الفعل هو design.

text.en: Designs. Layla designs new sofas and chairs.
text.ar: designs. ليلى تصمّم كنبات وكراسي جديدة.

text.en: Look! She blank an armchair right now. The verb is draw.
text.ar: Look! She فراغ an armchair right now. الفعل هو draw.

text.en: Is drawing. Look tells you it is happening now.
text.ar: is drawing. كلمة Look تخبرك أنّه يحدث الآن.

text.en: The factory blank furniture every day. The verb is make.
text.ar: The factory فراغ furniture every day. الفعل هو make.

text.en: Makes. Every day is a routine.
text.ar: makes. فـ every day روتين.

text.en: This week, the team blank a sofa for a customer. The verb is make.
text.ar: This week, the team فراغ a sofa for a customer. الفعل هو make.

text.en: Is making. This week means now, not always.
text.ar: is making. فـ this week تعني الآن، لا دائماً.

text.en: Now choose. Each of these could take either form, and one is right.
text.ar: الآن اختر. كلّ واحدة قد تأخذ أيّ صيغة، وواحدة صحيحة.

text.en: Right now, Khaled blank the team. Is it watches, or is watching?
text.ar: Right now, Khaled فراغ the team. أهي watches، أم is watching؟

text.en: Is watching. Right now cannot take the plain verb.
text.ar: is watching. فـ right now لا تقبل الفعل المجرّد.

text.en: Layla usually blank in the morning. Is it draws, or is drawing?
text.ar: Layla usually فراغ in the morning. أهي draws، أم is drawing؟

text.en: Draws. Usually is a routine, so the verb is plain with an S.
text.ar: draws. فـ usually روتين، فالفعل مجرّد مع حرف S.

text.en: Listen! Nour blank to a customer. Is it talks, or is talking?
text.ar: Listen! Nour فراغ to a customer. أهي talks، أم is talking؟

text.en: Is talking. Listen tells you it is happening now.
text.ar: is talking. كلمة Listen تخبرك أنّه يحدث الآن.

text.en: The factory blank sofas every week. Is it makes, or is making?
text.ar: The factory فراغ sofas every week. أهي makes، أم is making؟

text.en: Makes. Every week is a routine, like every day.
text.ar: makes. فـ every week روتين، مثل every day.

text.en: Two of those four were the simple. Look at the time phrase first.
text.ar: اثنتان من تلك الأربع كانتا بسيطتين. انظر إلى عبارة الزمن أوّلاً.
